jcr:title: Stryker Mobility Zone heads to inaugural PowerShares QQQ Championship for Schwab Cup playoffs

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., Oct. 26, 2016 /PRNewswire/ -- Stryker Orthopaedics, the Official Joint Replacement Products of the PGA TOUR® and PGA TOUR Champions, today announced it will be making its debut appearance at the PowerShares QQQ Championship – the opening event of the Charles Schwab Cup Playoffs. For the very first time, the company's onsite activation - the Stryker Mobility Zone – will be present for golf fans to engage with, in an effort to continue Stryker's mission of educating golf fans on the importance of joint health across the country. While on-site, local surgeons from the Southern California area will be able to address fans' questions regarding hip and knee pain.

Throughout the tournament, the Stryker Mobility Zone will aim to enhance golf fans' experience through the Stryker Challenge - a series of golf-inspired activities designed to address the importance of joint health and mobility. Additionally, fans will have the opportunity to enter for the chance to win a trip for two to TPC Sawgrass to play alongside longtime Stryker ambassadors Fred Funk and Hal Sutton.1,2
